component: Folder picker browser and unit assertion diagnostics

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The changed checked-property assertions and the added fourth-folder equality do not pass assertion messages. The current deliberate assertion guidance requires a nonempty message stating the expected behavior. The check values and nearby comments do not fill that message argument. This finding is limited to the inspected changed tests and does not imply that the asserted folder state is wrong.
title: Changed folder-selection checks omit expected-behavior messages
